senses.definition: abundance;—abs. מ׳ Is 33:23, as adv., in abundance.

increase(?), cstr. לְמַרְבֵּה (sic) 9:6 for the increase of the dominion (take לם as dittogr. of foregoing, and read רַבָּה, 𝔊 Gr Che Kit Buhl Lex Marti; Du לְמַרְבֵּה, in view of following לְשָׁלוֹם).
